name: Into the dragon’s lair

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

summary: The Drakefire Amulet opens the way to Onyxia’s Lair, where a band of champions at last faces the black dragon herself. The road began differently for those who came from Stormwind and those who answered the Horde’s call; each company enters beneath its own banners. Fire shivers across the stone as Onyxia takes wing. The struggle reaches its summit in this original Classic account, though its nameless adventurers are remembered as a company, not a single chosen champion.
